verdict.rationale: The California Franchise Tax Board is a state tax authority whose core product is the government's own filing and payment service. Self-hosting it is a category error, because the agency itself must be the counterparty that receives filings and payments. The evidence only records Akamai 403 walls at robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov, and nothing suggests any self-hostable distribution exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
